name: Quarter Tiling
description:
Turn half-tiled windows into quarter-tiled windows, with GNOME's tiling animation.

* Super+Up on a left/right half moves the window to the top quarter of that side.
* Super+Down on a left/right half moves the window to the bottom quarter of that side.
* Super+Down on a top quarter moves it to the bottom corner; Super+Up on a bottom quarter moves it to the top corner.
* Super+Up on a top quarter maximizes the window.

All other windows keep GNOME's normal Super+Up / Super+Down behaviour.
